corrections.after: Existing or available in large quantities.
corrections.before: Present in a quantity that easily meets the need.
corrections.rationale: Abundant means existing in large quantity, not necessarily enough for a particular demand. Definition and Vietnamese gloss wrongly bind abundance to meeting a need. Fruit example otherwise appropriate.

corrections.before: có nhiều và đủ đáp ứng nhu cầu
corrections.rationale: Abundant means existing in large quantity, not necessarily enough for a particular demand. Definition and Vietnamese gloss wrongly bind abundance to meeting a need. Fruit example otherwise appropriate.

corrections.before: Strange or unusual in a way that attracts attention.
corrections.rationale: Weird can mean strange without necessarily attracting attention. Remove this nonessential restriction from the definition; clicking sound and kỳ lạ align.

corrections.after: Các tình nguyện viên ủng hộ một mục đích tốt đẹp ở địa phương.
corrections.before: Các tình nguyện viên ủng hộ một hoạt động địa phương đáng trân trọng.
corrections.rationale: Worthy describes deserving support, not objective worth certification. Local cause refers to an aim deserving support; hoạt động đáng trân trọng is understandable but narrower and shifts support to respect.

corrections.after: đuổi khỏi; trục xuất; khai trừ khỏi tổ chức
corrections.rationale: Expel from an organization covers club exclusion. Khai trừ is accurate in the example, but primary gloss omits this supported sense and could misleadingly suggest only geographic removal.

corrections.after: Anh ấy hét lên để người khác nghe được giữa tiếng ồn.
corrections.before: Anh ấy hét lên để át tiếng ồn.
corrections.rationale: Yelled to be heard is speaking loudly enough for others to hear over noise. Vietnamese để át tiếng ồn can suggest drowning noise out rather than being audible; propose more faithful purpose wording.
Funding definition denotes money provided, whereas sự tài trợ names support process. Kinh phí is right; add tiền tài trợ as primary monetary gloss to avoid process/material ambiguity.

corrections.after: Countable restriction in this proposal; the uncountable act of limiting needs separate boundary review before inclusion.
corrections.before: Countable restriction; uncountable limiting process also possible.
corrections.rationale: Restriction Sense fits battery limitation. Grammar also mentions uncountable limiting process absent from the definition; clarify that note so owner can decide separate process usage rather than assume exhaustive coalescence.
